name: 1P-ETH-LAD
summary: A new psychedelic lysergamide which is suspected to be a prodrug of ETH-LAD, which could explain why the doses are very similar, it alternatively could be active on its own. There are no studies on it currently.
advisory: These doses are very tentative, and are based on the likelihood that the dosage profile will be similar to ETH-LAD.
